name: wabi
description: The operating platform for WhatsApp Business, by Meter: connect your own WhatsApp Business Account (or start on a simulated sandbox number), send and receive messages, manage templates, contacts and AI support agents, and read usage and costs, from the conversation, the CLI or CI.
